newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish share record spree ends, more falls seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish share record spree ends, more falls seen.

text.p: The 13-trading day Danish share index record spree ended on Friday as expected in falls and dealers said they expected a period of general consolidation to set in ahead of the first-half 1997 corporate results season due to start in mid-August.
"I think we will see prices slipping further. The KFX index could fall to 190 in the days ahead," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index lost 3.49 point to close at 192.12 in overall bourse turnover of 1.959 billion crowns. The KFX August future fell 4.25 point to 191.50 with 409 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Only two KFX shares noted gains. SAS and Den Danske Bank both ended the week three crowns higher at 100 and 770 crowns respectively, the former bolstered by a recommendation from Britain's NatWest Securities.
